metadata.scenario: A new customer calls to dispute a charge on their recent invoice, claiming they were overcharged. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Rose Patterson. I'm calling about a charge on my recent invoice. Hi Rose, nice to hear from you. What seems to be the issue with the charge? Well, I believe I was overcharged for the companion care services last week. I understand your concern. Let me pull up your account and take a look at that invoice. Can you please hold for just a moment? Sure, take your time. Thank you for holding, Rose. I see that you were charged for 30 hours of companion care last week, but your usual schedule is 25 hours. That’s right! I only need 25 hours a week. I don’t understand why I was billed for extra hours. It appears there was a scheduling error on our end. I apologize for the confusion. Let me correct that for you. I appreciate that. When will the correction be reflected in my account? Once I process the adjustment, it should reflect in your account within 3-5 business days. Okay, that sounds good. Can you also clarify the rate charged for my care? Of course! You’re currently set at $28 per hour for personal care assistance and $25 per hour for companion care. Perfect, that’s what I expected. Thank you for confirming. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Yes, actually. I’d like to discuss adding a physical therapy session for my son. We can certainly arrange that. Our physical therapy sessions are $110 to $140. What day were you considering? Maybe next Thursday? Let me check our schedule for Thursday. It looks like we have availability in the afternoon. Would 2 PM work for you? Yes, that works great. Please go ahead and book that. I’ll confirm that appointment for you, along with the invoice adjustment. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help today. My pleasure, Rose! Thank you for being a valued client. Have a great day! You too! Goodbye.
